FaqPage.title: FAQ
FaqPage.description: Frequently asked questions about booking, payment, cancellation, and house rules.

booking.title: 💳 Booking & Payment
booking.q1: How do I confirm my booking?
booking.a1: Your booking is officially confirmed once our management company (Cloud 9) receives a deposit of 50% or more of the total booking amount.
booking.q2: What payment methods and currencies are accepted?
booking.a2: We accept bank transfer or credit card (Visa, MasterCard). All charges are in Japanese Yen (JPY).
booking.q3: When is the remaining balance due?
booking.a3: The remaining balance must be paid at least 10 weeks before your check-in date. Please pay on time — if overdue, the reservation will be automatically cancelled and the deposit will not be refunded.

cancellation.title: ❌ Cancellation & Refunds
cancellation.q4: Can I cancel and get a refund if my plans change?
cancellation.a4_intro: Our cancellation policy is as follows (based on when you notify us):
cancellation.a4_policy1: More than 24 weeks before check-in: 25% of the deposit paid will be deducted.
cancellation.a4_policy2: More than 10 weeks before check-in: 50% of the deposit paid will be deducted.
cancellation.a4_policy3: Within 10 weeks before check-in: 100% of the total room rate will be charged (non-refundable).
cancellation.a4_policy4: No-show: 100% of the total room rate will be charged (non-refundable).
cancellation.q5: If I decide to shorten my stay, can I get a refund for unused nights?
cancellation.a5: If you do not check in (No Show) or decide to check out early after arrival, we are unable to refund the remaining nights.

rules.title: 🔑 House Rules & Check-in
rules.q6: What are the check-in and check-out times?
rules.q7: Is smoking or bringing pets allowed?
rules.a7_smoke: 🚭 No Smoking: All indoor areas are strictly non-smoking (including e-cigarettes). If discovered, a substantial special cleaning and deodorizing fee will be charged.
rules.a7_pets: 🐾 No Pets: Pets are not permitted anywhere on the property.
rules.q8: Can we drink and have a party in the living room at night?
rules.a8: We warmly welcome you to relax and enjoy yourselves, but please respect your neighbors' peace and quiet. Large parties are strictly prohibited, and please keep noise levels down after 10:00 PM.
